analyst_view.overall: Early view: a bottom-half game between 16th-placed Casa Pia and 13th-placed Nacional, two points apart, so both will treat it as a key game for staying up. Nacional are on their fourth coach of the season, João Henriques, who started in late October and called the team still in a process of adapting. Casa Pia, under first-season coach Filipe Coelho, scored only once in their first six league games.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals. Casa Pia have struggled to score all season and Nacional are still settling under a new coach, so both are likely to play it safe in a game neither can afford to lose. I lean a little lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. I found nothing on either side's style that points away from that. I keep it level until nearer the game.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards. Games between sides fighting to stay up tend to be tense and broken up by fouls, and both clubs have been under pressure, with Nacional changing coach three times. I lean slightly higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots. Neither attack has been sharp: Casa Pia scored once in their first six league games, and a nervous, cautious game is more likely than an open one. I lean a little lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target, which looks high for two of the league's weaker attacks. With caution likely on both sides, I lean lower.
